correctness.rationale: Reconstructed stationary generator moment recursion for X and Y through order six and independent Gaussian convolution; independent symbolic rational algebra matched K4,K6 formulas and derivative numerator polynomials P4,P6, temperature-invariant ratio K6^2/K4^3, and the H-polynomial strict comparison. For q>=0 descending coefficient patterns of P4/P6 each have one sign change, and endpoint signs force one positive root; correct boundary q=0 finite cumulant limits and q>0 vanish at b->0. H(b)>0 for b<=5 via explicit polynomial comparison, P4(5,q)>0, so positive derivative of log K6 at b4 proves strict ordering globally. Checked monotonic thermal shift by logarithmic-derivative comparison and bounded limit roots. These analytical sign arguments establish universal statements, not a finite grid.
residual_risks: No extension to correlated thermal noise, non-Poisson resets, other cumulant orders or inertial traps.

value.rationale: Unique, strictly ordered reset-rate optimizers are a natural control/diagnostics fact for two genuinely distinct normalized non-Gaussian observables. Global invariance under arbitrarily strong independent thermal broadening is nontrivial and avoids misleading finite-temperature numerical observations. The dimensionless all-q statement has standalone statistical-physics value even without a downstream general theorem.
residual_risks: Only overdamped one-dimensional stationary model and cumulants 4,6.

final_claim: For active Brownian forcing reset at Poisson epochs in a harmonic trap plus independent Gaussian thermal noise, standardized stationary cumulants K4,K6 have unique global positive reset-rate maxima b4(q),b6(q) that strictly increase with q and satisfy b4(q)<b6(q) for all finite q>=0.
limitations: Maxima approach finite limits as q grows, not asserted uniform at q=infinity.
Prior q=0 moments and Gaussian convolution are not claimed as new.
